mcq_fix.s: Green cements such as Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC) and Portland Slag Cement (PSC) use which combination of industrial by-products?
mcq_fix.why: PPC uses fly ash; slag is used in PSC, not PPC

notes_fix.replace: PPC = fly ash (pozzolana); slag → Portland Slag Cement (PSC)
notes_fix.why: established fact: slag cement is PSC, not PPC

notes_fix.replace: Fly ash (thermal plants); slag (steel plants) is used in Portland Slag Cement (PSC)
notes_fix.why: established fact: PPC = pozzolanic fly ash; slag -> PSC

patterns: Steel plant - collaborating country / state matching dominates (Bhilai & Bokaro = USSR, Rourkela = Germany, Durgapur = UK); location logic (near raw material vs not) is a favourite trap.
FIRSTs asked as single facts: Fort Gloster 1818, first cement 1904 Madras (APPSC G2 2024/25), first sugar mill Pratappur 1903, SAIL year.
Industry-centre matching (APPSC 2023: Jamshedpur-steel, Kolkata-jute, Barauni-refinery, ICF-Perambur; Chunar-cement, Ludhiana-hosiery, Sakkar Nagar-sugar).
Sugar: leading states order, north-to-south shift reasons, India's world rank; raw materials of fertiliser/cement as 'which is not' items.
App MCQs add many 2025-26 data and statement-count items (shares, capacities, CCTS sectors) that go deeper than PYQs, which stay at rank/place level.
